P7431.corridor_notes: 粤电云河专线项目：起于粤西天然气主干管网肇庆-云浮支干线云浮分输站，终于云安分输站，途经云浮市云城区、云安区，全长38.848公里。已于2024-09-03完成72小时试运行并正式投产，设计年输气能力24.7亿标方，主要向粤电云河电厂及云浮市主要城区供气。 Length (38.848km) matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (38.85) closely.
P7431.researcher_notes: china5e.com (energy-industry news portal) confirms exact GEM StartLocation/EndLocation station names verbatim (云浮分输站 / 云安分输站) and length (38.848km vs GEM 38.85km). Station-level coordinates not locatable in OSM/Nominatim; used district/seat-level centroids instead (finest available geocodable level).
